'''Rott Mercer'''<ref name="TVG">''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte: The Visual Guide]]''</ref> was a [[Cybernetics|cybernetic]] [[Rott Mercer's species|alien]] convict who was present on the ''[[Palwick]]'', a [[prison]] [[transport]], during the [[High Republic Era]]. During an escape attempt, the convict managed to disable the [[pilot droid]]s who controlled the [[Starship|ship]].<ref name="Episode I" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Rott Mercer made their debut in the [[Lost / Found|first episode]] of the [[2024]] television series, ''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte]]'', directed by [[Leslye Headland]],<ref name="Episode I" /> before being shown in better detail in previews for the ''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte: The Visual Guide]]''.<ref name="TVG" /> They were designed by concept artist [[Ivan Manzella]], who experimented with making them blue, though the more human-like appearance was later settled upon.<ref name="Manzella">{{WebCite|url=https://www.krop.com/ivanmanzella|text=Ivan Manzella Creatures & Character Designs|author=Manzella, Ivan|work=[https://www.krop.com Krop]|archivedate=20190121223617}}</ref>
